title: CEA-Leti and Quobly strengthen collaboration to accelerate development of next-gen silicon quantum technologies
key_facts: Quobly and CEA-Leti strengthen collaboration via FAMES Pilot Line
Quobly founded in 2022 on 15+ years of CEA-Leti and CNRS research
Works with STMicroelectronics on 300 mm manufacturing
QSoI architecture combines silicon spin qubits with FD-SoI platform
Plans first computer, Alloy Pioneer, by end of 2026
Roadmap targets one million qubits by 2032
quote_evidence: Quobly plans to commercialize its first quantum computer, Alloy Pioneer, by the end of 2026
Quobly can access advanced semiconductor equipment and process modules
why_it_matters_hint: Access to pilot line for next-generation chips.
